name: ng18_19_destroy_test_set
description: A four-way intersection structure at (20..21, 20..21); destroying the piece at (20, 20) alone: it is a destroyed cell, removed with RemoveOccupant; the other three, pulled in by the closure, go through RemoveOrReplaceOccupant. Here it puts plain pieces back at (21, 20) and (20, 21), whose cells join the re-solve set; (21, 21) is erased from it. Keys are (x << 16) + z (NG7).
